repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR requires a sustained wait of 10 minutes (600,000 ms) before acting. The candidate uses a 1000 ms wrapper period and a threshold of 600 ticks. Since the condition is true at t=0, the candidate counts 1 tick immediately, reaching the threshold at t=599,000 ms (599 ticks elapsed + 1 initial). The IR does not act until t=600,000 ms. The mismatch at 599,000 ms confirms the action fired one period too early due to the off-by-one error in the threshold calculation for a 100 ms grid.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed the wrapper period from 1000 ms to 100 ms to match the fine-grained sustain requirement. Updated the threshold from 600 to 6001 (10 minutes / 100 ms + 1) to ensure the action fires exactly at the 10-minute mark, preserving the IR's timing.
